# Command-line reference

This reference is generated from the same CLI11 definitions used by the `wavlab` executable.

## `wavlab`

```text
Inspect and process PCM WAV files


wavlab [OPTIONS] SUBCOMMAND


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
  -V,     --version           Display program version information and exit

SUBCOMMANDS:
  sine-wave                   Generate a mono sine-wave WAV file
  square-wave                 Generate a mono square-wave WAV file
  square-wave-additive        Generate a band-limited square wave by additive synthesis
  triangle-wave               Generate a mono triangle-wave WAV file
  triangle-wave-additive      Generate a band-limited triangle wave by additive synthesis
  sawtooth-wave               Generate a mono sawtooth-wave WAV file
  sawtooth-wave-additive      Generate a band-limited sawtooth wave by additive synthesis
  white-noise                 Generate a mono white-noise WAV file
  pink-noise                  Generate a mono pink-noise WAV file
  metadata, stat              Display WAV metadata and optionally scan levels
  normalise, normalize        Normalise the peak level to 0 dBFS
  normalise-db, normalize-db  Normalise the peak to a specified level in dBFS
  gain                        Multiply every sample by a linear gain factor
  gain-db                     Apply amplitude gain measured in decibels
  reverse                     Reverse audio frames while retaining channel order
  flip-phase                  Invert the polarity of every sample
  swap-channels               Swap stereo left and right channels
  split-stereo                Split stereo into separate mono left/right files
  split-mid-side              Split stereo into separate mono mid/side files
  left-right-to-stereo        Combine mono left/right files into stereo
  mid-side-to-stereo          Decode mono mid/side files into stereo
  split                       Split a WAV file at one or more millisecond positions
  mix                         Mix two or more WAV files from the first frame
  join                        Join two or more compatible WAV files end-to-end
  get-peak-db                 Compatibility command: print peak level in dBFS
  get-rms-db                  Compatibility command: print RMS level in dBFS
  eq-peak                     Apply a peaking EQ boost or cut
  eq-lowshelf                 Apply a low-shelf EQ boost or cut
  eq-highshelf                Apply a high-shelf EQ boost or cut
  eq-allpass                  Apply an all-pass filter that changes phase while preserving
                              magnitude
  eq-bandpass                 Apply a constant-skirt-gain band-pass filter
  eq-lowpass                  Apply a 12 dB-per-octave low-pass filter
  eq-highpass                 Apply a 12 dB-per-octave high-pass filter
  saturate                    Apply sigmoid soft clipping like tape saturation
  digital-delay-mono          Apply clean delay with common channel settings
  digital-delay-stereo        Apply clean stereo delay with independent channel settings
  analog-delay-mono           Apply low-pass-filtered delay with common settings
  analog-delay-stereo         Apply low-pass-filtered stereo delay with independent settings
  tape-delay-mono             Apply saturated, low-pass-filtered delay with common settings
  tape-delay-stereo           Apply saturated stereo delay with independent channel settings
  chorus-mono                 Apply common-setting chorus to every channel
  chorus-stereo               Apply independent stereo chorus
  vibrato-mono                Apply fully wet chorus as pitch modulation
  vibrato-stereo              Apply independent stereo pitch modulation
  flanger-mono                Apply common-setting triangle-LFO flanging
  flanger-stereo              Apply independent stereo flanging
  tremolo                     Apply LFO-controlled volume modulation
  autopan                     Apply LFO-controlled panning and always output stereo
  phaser-mono                 Apply common-setting multi-stage phasing
  phaser-stereo               Apply independent stereo multi-stage phasing
  modulated-filter            Apply an LFO-modulated low/high-pass filter
  reverb                      Apply classic Schroeder algorithmic reverb

Run 'wavlab COMMAND --help' for detailed command usage.
```

## `wavlab sine-wave`

```text
Generate a mono sine-wave WAV file


wavlab sine-wave [OPTIONS] OUTPUT FREQUENCY SAMPLE_RATE BIT_DEPTH LENGTH_MS


POSITIONALS:
  OUTPUT TEXT REQUIRED        Destination WAV file
  FREQUENCY FLOAT REQUIRED    Frequency in Hz
  SAMPLE_RATE UINT REQUIRED   Output sample rate in Hz
  BIT_DEPTH UINT:{8,16,24,32} REQUIRED
                              Integer PCM depth: 8, 16, 24, or 32
  LENGTH_MS UINT REQUIRED     Output length in milliseconds

OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit

Run 'wavlab COMMAND --help' for detailed command usage.
```

## `wavlab split-stereo`

```text
Split stereo into separate mono left/right files

POSITIONALS:
  INPUT TEXT:FILE REQUIRED    Stereo PCM WAV file to split
  LEFT_OUTPUT TEXT Needs: RIGHT_OUTPUT
                              First output; omit both outputs to derive filenames
  RIGHT_OUTPUT TEXT Needs: LEFT_OUTPUT
                              Second output; omit both outputs to derive filenames

OPTIONS:

Run 'wavlab COMMAND --help' for detailed command usage.
```
